cli.usage:
Usage: board <command> [options]

Commands:
  projects                       List projects
  import [path] [--key k] [--title t] [--include dir]... [--dry-run]
                                 Import an app (and the workspace packages it uses) as a project
  checkout <project> [dir] [--rev main|vN]
                                 Download a project into a folder
  push [-m message]              Send changes in this checkout as a new version
  pull                           Update this checkout to the latest version
  versions [-p project]          List versions
  diff <from> [to] [-p project]  List paths changed between versions

Options: --server <url> (or BOARD_URL), --json, --version
cli.projects.none: No projects yet. Import one with `board import <path>`.
cli.import.plan: Would import {count} files as project {key} from {source}:
cli.push.nothing: Nothing to push: no changes since the last version.
cli.push.conflict: Someone pushed first. Commit or set aside your changes, run `board pull`, then push again.
cli.pull.dirty: This checkout has unpushed changes. Push them first.
cli.error.noProject: Which project? Pass -p <project> or run inside a checkout.
cli.error.noCheckout: Not inside a checkout. Run `board checkout <project>` first.
cli.error.unreachable: Cannot reach the board server. Is it running? (set BOARD_URL or --server)
